t: You're looking at a bronze statue of James Henry Greathead, standing on a traffic island in the middle of Cornhill, outside the Royal Exchange, with traffic passing on either side. It was put up in 1994, and the sculptor was James Butler. The statue also conceals a ventilation shaft. Greathead was a civil engineer renowned for his work on the London Underground, and his invention is the reason the Underground is colloquially called the Tube. The London Troops War Memorial is nearby.
